name: @justfortytwo/installer
description: All-in-one installer and lifecycle CLI for fortytwo — scaffolds the persona surface and provisions the npm engine (memory MCP, safety gate, channel adapters, embedder).

fortytwo.comment: Compatibility contract this CLI version was authored against — the SINGLE source of truth for engine sibling versions (deliberately not peerDependencies: npm would hard-fail installer upgrades with ERESOLVE whenever an installed sibling sits outside the new range). init installs these ranges, doctor cross-checks the *installed* siblings against them, update resolves latest-in-range and records the set into .fortytwo/state.json for rollback.
